understanding: Les capteurs de mouvement utilisent un champ infrarouge pour capturer chaque mouvement précisément.

candidates.action: A stream of red infrared signal emerges from the motion sensor and sweeps across the room in a wide, visible arc.
candidates.explains: This shows the sensor actively emitting signals to detect motion in its environment.
candidates.misses: It doesn't explain how the sensor can capture movements precisely.

candidates.action: The internal components of the sensor light up in blue as the red infrared signal makes contact with a moving object.
candidates.explains: This illustrates how the sensor processes motion detection internally upon capturing movement.
candidates.misses: It does not explicitly show the range or the continuous presence of the infrared signal.

candidates.action: The red infrared signal continuously emanates from the sensor, highlighting the presence of multiple moving objects it detects.
candidates.explains: This action confirms the infrared signal's role in detecting each movement in the defined space.
candidates.misses: It doesn't show the inner workings of the sensor or detail the precision of the capture.

chosen: The red infrared signal continuously emanates from the sensor, highlighting the presence of multiple moving objects it detects.
why_chosen: This action clearly shows the motion sensor's function of emitting an infrared field to detect movements, providing a visual of detection in action with multiple objects as evidence.
